search_date_only: SELECT screening_id,movie_title,start_time,total_seats,sold_seats,available_seats FROM vw_screening_search WHERE screening_date='2026-11-01' AND screening_status='OPEN' AND available_seats>0 ORDER BY start_time,branch_id,room_id,screening_id LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0
search_branch_date: SELECT screening_id,movie_title,start_time,total_seats,sold_seats,available_seats FROM vw_screening_search WHERE branch_id=1 AND screening_date='2026-11-01' AND screening_status='OPEN' AND available_seats>0 ORDER BY start_time,branch_id,room_id,screening_id LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0
search_summary: SELECT COUNT(*),COALESCE(SUM(available_seats),0),COALESCE(SUM(sold_seats),0) FROM vw_screening_search WHERE screening_date='2026-11-01' AND screening_status='OPEN' AND available_seats>0
overlap_check: SELECT screening_id FROM screening WHERE room_id=1 AND status='OPEN' AND start_time<'2026-11-01 23:00:00' AND end_time>'2026-11-01 19:00:00'
seat_lookup: SELECT seat_id FROM screening_seat_lock WHERE screening_id=1 AND seat_id=1
revenue_branches: SELECT br.branch_id,br.branch_code,br.branch_name,br.city,COUNT(DISTINCT vr.booking_id),COALESCE(SUM(vr.valid_ticket_count),0),COALESCE(SUM(vr.recognized_revenue),0) FROM cinema_branch br LEFT JOIN vw_verified_booking_revenue vr ON vr.branch_id=br.branch_id AND vr.revenue_date BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-30' WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY br.branch_id,br.branch_code,br.branch_name,br.city ORDER BY 7 DESC,br.branch_id
revenue_daily: SELECT revenue_date,branch_code,branch_name,paid_booking_count,paid_ticket_count,total_paid_revenue FROM vw_branch_daily_revenue WHERE revenue_date BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-30' ORDER BY revenue_date,branch_code
sales_occupancy: SELECT screening_id,screening_date,start_time,end_time,branch_name,room_name,room_type,movie_title,room_capacity,tickets_sold,available_seats,occupancy_rate_pct,sales_revenue,screening_status FROM vw_screening_occupancy WHERE screening_date BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-30' ORDER BY start_time,screening_id
seat_map: SELECT st.seat_id,st.room_id,st.seat_row,st.seat_number,st.seat_type_code,tp.type_name,tp.surcharge,(sc.base_price+tp.surcharge) AS final_unit_price,CASE WHEN sl.ticket_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_occupied FROM screening sc JOIN seat st ON st.room_id=sc.room_id JOIN seat_type tp ON tp.seat_type_code=st.seat_type_code LEFT JOIN screening_seat_lock sl ON sl.screening_id=sc.screening_id AND sl.seat_id=st.seat_id WHERE sc.screening_id=1 ORDER BY st.seat_row,st.seat_number
overlap_via_search_view: SELECT screening_id,movie_id,movie_code,movie_title,duration_minutes,age_rating,room_id,room_name,room_type,branch_id,branch_code,branch_name,start_time,end_time,base_price,screening_status,total_seats,sold_seats,available_seats FROM vw_screening_search WHERE room_id=1 AND screening_status='OPEN' AND start_time<'2026-11-01 23:00:00' AND end_time>'2026-11-01 19:00:00'
